logicDrivers.doctrine: seven books, weighted by what actually gated or steered decisions this cycle

modules.tharp: risk sizing · RR gate · expectancy · DD rails
modules.murphy: TA sponsorship · regime mapping · noise floor
modules.pape: margin reserve · equity floor · allocation buffers
modules.kiyosaki: PnL retention · banked winners · runner trails
modules.clason: treasury guard · per-symbol ban · cooldown jaws

actions: kill-switch (real equity dd 99.96% >= 95%) — no new entries

risk.sizingUsd: all free margin / 4 target slots (~25% equity each) × risk multiplier
risk.leverageRule: contract maxLever, bounded so the stop stays inside the liq band: lev <= 80/(stopPct+0.64); carry/mandate orders floored at SENTINEL_MIN_LEV (20) when the band holds it
risk.protectionRule: exactly one TP + one SL per position; orphan positions get protection synthesized; entry emergency-closes if protection placement fails — never naked
risk.rebalanceRule: a position holding > slot margin gets partially closed to free balance for other slots
risk.disconnectRule: TP/SL are exchange-side plan orders — a VPS/network outage cannot leave a position unprotected

idleMargin.reason: below top-up floor + contract minimums — dust, undeployable

byPosition.scope: close fills grouped into positions via entriesLog join (riskUsd entry anchor); campaign:* = pre-instrumentation clusters by symbol+side; preEpoch excluded from headline

allTime.scope: all real exchange fill journals (live + demo books) — FIFO position episodes per symbol

funding.note: delta-neutral funding harvest: long spot + short perp collects positive 8h funding. indicative estimates, bitget USDT-FUTURES.
